title_zh: 就业人员工资—纵向序列
description_en: Continuous official annual wage and growth histories for like-for-like national, regional and industry concepts across retained classification eras.
description_zh: 跨已保留分类时期、按可比全国、地区和行业概念连接的官方年度工资及增速历史。
coverage_en: Comparable official observations from 2010 to 2025; classification and 2012 coverage breaks remain explicit in row provenance and notes.
coverage_zh: 2010—2025年可比官方观测；分类变化及2012年统计口径变化仍在逐行来源和注释中明确保留。
series_note_en: Official levels are joined without rebasing or interpolation. The non-private wage coverage changes from in-post workers to employed persons in 2012; users should treat that date as a level-series break.
series_note_zh: 官方水平值不作重定基或插值。2012年非私营单位工资口径由在岗职工转为就业人员，使用者应将该年视为水平序列断点。
source_note: Official NBS annual wage releases are retained with exact source URLs and SHA-256 provenance; duplicate prior-year columns are resolved to the latest retained official publication.

description_en: Longitudinal official indicators reconstructed from repeated observations in the retained 2012–25 migrant-worker monitoring reports.
description_zh: 依据已保留的2012—2025年农民工监测调查报告中的重复观测整理的官方纵向指标。
coverage_en: Like-for-like indicators with at least nine observed years; major population, age, industry and income series extend through 2025.
coverage_zh: 至少含九个观测年度的同口径指标；主要规模、年龄、行业及收入序列延伸至2025年。
series_note_en: Repeated observations are deduplicated by concept and observation year, retaining the latest official report available in the frozen archive. Sparse release cells remain available in the native-table archive; no interpolation or synthetic backcast is used.
series_note_zh: 重复观测按指标概念和观测年度去重，并保留冻结档案中最新的官方报告。稀疏发布单元仍可在原始表档案中查阅；未使用插值或合成回溯。
source_note: Official NBS migrant-worker reports and exact source hashes are retained; source-vintage provenance identifies the report selected for each observation.
